params.text: Treasure transport to Europe -- the King's cut (spec/systems/natives.md func_05C878). @KINGGALLEON2 is an OFFER: with no galleon of your own, the Crown proposes to ship the treasure and take a cut. Cut% = Hernan Cortes (ff.10) ? tax : min(max(5*diff+50, 2*tax), 90). You KEEP treasure - treasure*cut/100 -- but only if you accept; declining ships nothing and grants nothing (the treasure stays in the New World). One Formula computes the kept amount; the grant is gated behind the accept choice. (treasure proxied by the treasury here.)

params.title: The Crown's Galleon

params.title: Treasure Delivered
params.body: The Crown's galleon delivers your treasure to Europe, less its cut. You now hold {power0.gold} gold.

params.title: Treasure Kept
params.body: You keep the treasure in the New World, awaiting a galleon of your own to ship it.

from.pin: Keep it in the New World
